name: claude-quenching
description: Marketplace hosting the claude-quenching plugin: an OKF-centric knowledge-base aligner, inserter, task-backlog capturer and triager, knowledge-capturer, glossary-curator, memory-to-docs migrator, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md harness-refactorer, external-source importer, skill minter and skill-surface aligner, run-to-convergence cycle, and OpenSpec spec-driven change cycle for the Claude Code surface of any repository.

plugins.name: claude-quenching
plugins.description: Forces any repository's docs/ knowledge base into a single canonical Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.1) bundle and keeps it conformant. Nineteen skills — align (structure), add (any doc), learn (concepts), define + glossary-backfill (the fixed A–Z term lookup), import-memory (drain project memory), harness (thin CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md pointers), new + align under the skill: namespace (the repo's own .claude skill/command surface under one taxonomy), import (external sources), converge (run everything to convergence), plus the eight openspec-* skills driving the OpenSpec spec-driven change cycle with OKF knowledge bridges — six CLI-derived (explore/propose/implement/revise/sync-specs/archive) plus the quenching-native openspec-backlog + openspec-backlog-triage task inbox. Every skill is user-invocable: false behind a thin command wrapper (/docs:* and /skill:* for quenching-*, /opsx:* for openspec-*), plus a self-contained enforcement hook. The routing story lives in each skill's own description. Every repository that adopts it looks the same.
